name: @yuuqq/jules-dispatch
stderr:
Usage: jules-dispatch [options] [command]

Batch-dispatch tasks to Google Jules + MCP server for Claude Code / Codex

Options:
  -V, --version                                  output the version number
  -p, --project <dir>                            project directory with .env (default: ".")
  --api-key <key>                                Jules API key (overrides JULES_API_KEY env var)
  --llm-key <key>                                [optional planner] LLM API key (overrides LLM_API_KEY / OPENAI_API_KEY)
  --llm-base-url <url>                           [optional planner] OpenAI-compatible base URL (default: https://api.openai.com/v1)
  --llm-model <model>                            [optional planner] model id (default: gpt-4o-mini)
  --json                                         machine-readable JSON output (one JSON object per command, NDJSON for streams) (default: false)
  -v, --verbose                                  log HTTP requests, timing, and error stacks to stderr (or set JULES_DISPATCH_VERBOSE=1)
  -h, --help                                     display help for command

Commands:
  dispatch [options] <taskFile>                  Dispatch a single task file to Jules. Use "-" to read from stdin.
  batch [options] [taskDir]                      Dispatch all .yaml/.yml/.json task files in a directory (supports multi-document YAML)
  status [options]                               Check status of recent Jules sessions
  get <sessionId>                                Get full details of a single session
  wait [options] [ids...]                        Poll until sessions are terminal, require action, or time out
  sources                                        List all GitHub sources connected to Jules (auto-paginates)
  message <sessionId> <text>                     Send a follow-up message to a running Jules session
  plan <sessionId>                               Show the latest generated plan for a session
  approve <sessionId>                            Approve the plan for a session waiting on plan approval
  cancel <sessionId>                             Cancel a running Jules session
  doctor [options]                               Validate Node.js, npm, Jules configuration, API connectivity, and task files
  init [options]                                 Set up API key and defaults for first-run (interactive wizard)
  tail [options] <sessionId>                     Tail activity log for a session in real time (until completion or Ctrl+C)
  plan-tasks|plan-batch [options] <description>  [OPTIONAL] Use any OpenAI-compatible LLM to expand a high-level intent into N independent Jules tasks (does NOT dispatch). Use "-" to read description from stdin.
  auto [options] <description>                   [OPTIONAL] Plan tasks with any OpenAI-compatible LLM AND dispatch them to Jules in one shot. Use "-" for stdin.
  mcp [options]                                  Run as an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server over stdio for Claude Code / Codex
  help [command]                                 display help for command

Getting started:
  $ jules-dispatch dispatch task.yaml     # dispatch your first task
  $ jules-dispatch status                 # check progress
  $ jules-dispatch doctor                 # validate your setup

Docs: https://github.com/Yuuqq/jules-dispatch
